coverage_explanation: Exercises A0 at both endpoints, an intermediate value, and a repeated endpoint. Counts only rising edges of D13 over long settled windows, thereby bounding complete blink-cycle rates without imposing a duty cycle or a minimum ON-pulse duration. The accepted rate envelope accommodates both complete-cycle and per-toggle interpretations of 0.2–2 seconds. Coverage is partial: the requirement does not specify mapping direction or shape, and the supported assertion schema cannot compare measured cycle rates across input plateaus. Thus these checks do not establish A0-dependent rate changes or attainment of both timing endpoints; a fixed-rate blinker within the envelope can pass.
assumptions: Uses the disclosed bench default: D13 drives an active-HIGH LED, with its cathode connected through a resistor to GND.
A0 is a raw ADC input from 0 through 1023 using the default 5 V reference.
Startup phase, initial LED state, duty cycle, ADC-to-time mapping direction, and mapping shape are unspecified.

The wording does not resolve whether 0.2–2 seconds describes a complete blink cycle or each toggle interval. The checks conservatively accommodate complete cycles from 200 through 4000 ms, without constraining individual pulse widths.
Settled observation windows exclude 4.5 seconds after each input change, allowing a previous cycle to finish.
The reference chooses a linear increasing ADC-to-toggle-interval mapping of 200–2000 ms and equal ON/OFF durations. These are permitted reference choices, not additional candidate requirements.
